articles.summary: Kilroy Realty Corporation (NYSE: KRC) (“Kilroy” or the “Company”) today reported financial and operational results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Momentum in our West Coast markets continued to accelerate in the third quarter, with over 800,000 square feet of long-term leases signed, representing one of the Company’s highest quarterly leasing volumes since 2019,” said Angela Aman, Chief Executive Officer. “The breadth of activity was particularly notable, as we recorded sequential leased occupancy gains across all five of our regions and strong re-leasing spreads, driven by activity from a wide variety of users and industries. Looking ahead, our high-quality portfolio, solid balance sheet, and nimble approach position us well to capitalize on the real-time fundamental improvements we are seeing across our regions.” Financial Results Revenues of $271.6 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $279.7 million for the quarter ended September 30,
articles.title: Kilroy Realty Corporation Reports Third Quarter Financial and Operational Results
